protocol.history: One global 288-slot/cell noisy-observation mean across all six development cases and both days; eligible visible observations only; no case-specific profile
protocol.weighted_base: Matches StateFeatures temporal age weight 1/(1+age/10), spatial weight .35, prior fallback
protocol.source_weight_training: Original public-train A33 only; no synthetic fine-tuning
protocol.profile_limit: Same fixed generator clock in dev histories can be overly informative; +1h incident assessment shift reported separately
protocol.selection: No model/mode/shift selection; all preregistered factors retained

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limitations: Own fixed-clock history and same generator family, not organizer distribution. Only three assessment seed clusters. Factor comparisons share targets within each case; different patterns and clocks have different target populations. No assessment tuning or production promotion.
